name: Tanit bint Abdmelqart

attacks.label: Vicious Mockery
attacks.on_fail: disadvantage on next attack roll before end of your next turn

background_story: Carthaginian heritage. Family is in the Tyrian purple dye trade — the most valuable commodity in the ancient world, a Phoenician monopoly. Carries the memory of a civilization Rome destroyed. Her name is Carthaginian. Her family still profits from the Roman empire that erased her people's history. Survival vs identity is her engine.
notes: Alignment True Neutral. Charlatan background: proficiency Disguise kit, Forgery kit. Bard: Bardic Inspiration d8 (3/LR), Jack of All Trades, Song of Rest. College of Eloquence: Silver Tongue (Persuasion+Deception treat d20 roll 9 or lower as 10), Unsettling Words (BA: expend Bardic Inspiration die, target subtracts roll from next save before your next turn). Weapons: Dagger (Pugio) +5 / 1d4+3, Vicious Mockery (cantrip) 1d4 psychic DC 14. Personality: listens more than speaks; Knowledge is the only authority that cannot be revoked; carries a history Rome tried to erase. Passive Perception 14.
